svg.title: Eight original calendar pattern studies
svg.text: A-E: annual structure. F-H: content emphasis and scale. Exploratory studies.

svg.title: Month blocks
svg.desc: Annual overview. Twelve familiar monthly grids; Monday first.

svg.title: Continuous weeks
svg.desc: Annual overview. Weeks continue across month boundaries; outside-year days are pale.

svg.title: Month strips
svg.desc: Annual overview. Twelve parallel month strips, aligned by day of month.

svg.title: Radial year
svg.desc: A cyclical annual calendar. Every day has the same angular interval; month arcs follow real day counts.
svg.text: Equal angle per day. Month arcs follow their actual duration.

svg.title: Equal-day field
svg.desc: Annual day field, chronological left-to-right reading. Equal circles represent days, not weekdays or weeks.
svg.text: Left to right, then down. A dark circle begins a new month.

svg.title: Image-led month
svg.desc: An image-led monthly calendar. Original procedural wave artwork paired with an ordinary January month grid.

svg.title: Writing-led week
svg.desc: A weekly agenda with one lane per day and a separate notes area. Blank writing space is intentional.

svg.title: Date-led daily page
svg.desc: A single daily page with the date as the main image. One page is a sample of a serial daily calendar.
